req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a PUT request to update a non-existent task should return a 404 error. This behavior needs to be verified through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive case ensures that existing tasks can be updated successfully. The negative case checks that updating a non-existent task returns a 404 error. The boundary case tests the behavior when the task ID is at the edge of valid and invalid ranges.

tests.name: test_update_existing_task
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with ID 1.
expected: The response contains the updated task data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure it exists
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "A task for testing", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()

# Update the existing task
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json={"title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated description", "completed": True})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_non_existent_task
preconditions: No task with ID 999 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with ID 999.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update a non-existent task
response = client.put("/tasks/999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json() == {"detail": "Task with id 999 not found"}

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary_id
preconditions: No task with ID 0 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to update the task with ID 0.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update a task with boundary ID 0
response = client.put("/tasks/0", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary test", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json() == {"detail": "Task with id 0 not found"}
